title.en: Handling an appointment: confirm, reassign, complete (phone)

intro.sr: Administrator potvrđuje zakazani termin, prebacuje ga na drugog terapeuta i označava kao završen. Snimljeno na telefonu (390x844).
intro.en: An administrator confirms a booked appointment, hands it to another therapist and marks it as completed. Recorded on a phone (390x844).
